## tern-all-panels

One panel per **core panel type** plus `grafana-clock-panel`.

- TestData for deterministic frames
- Prometheus, Loki and Tempo for real ones

[Grafana docs](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/panels-visualizations/)
